transcript: Even though no 7 and 8 are higher Price and Higher Z-Score, within the distribution context of more then 100,000 Volume (1 through 6), within a small range, it represents a pick or top, after which Price breaks lower. However after the break Price again heads higher into 7 invalidating all those who decided to go low (Shorts, too soon). This represents a larger fractal, where Price had 1-6 Z-score/Price divergences, then Initial Impuls Tendency run downward (which will show the direction of the next bigger move), with Invalidation and Price picking above all 6 previous picks at 7 and 8. At 7-8 Price and Z-score are not diverging (compared to 1-6) but are picking new tops. This is an Invalidation Sweap Run, (for the Shorts after 6) but then starts to head consistently lower in a distribution of the accumulated Shorts. (7 pc) to culinate in a big overnight Price drop (gap).
